text:
maya: Hey team — we're bringing up mT-7b-v2 for a multitask bring-up (instr, QA, summarization, code). I want to redesign our holdout/anchor partitions so the evals exercise length/lang/task combos and reduce train leakage. Need dedupe heuristics + labeling handoff this week. pinging @raj @alex for quant and dedupe notes

raj: SG. Quick Q: can we reuse anchor_v1 or should we retire it? anchor_v1 has lots of overlap with recent ingests (noticed duplicates with ingestion-2025).

sophia: I'd vote retire and create fresh anchor_v2. Proposal: stratify by task x language x token-length. Minimal strata: short-QA (<=50 tokens), long-QA (51-512), code (>=512). For multilingual, split en / non-en. How many anchors per cell?

alex: For labeling throughput callout: labeling-bot, what's queue and ETA if we push a high-priority pilot of 200 samples?

labeling-bot: Current queue: 1,220 items. Normal throughput ~200 items/day. With priority bump + extra annotators, ETA for 200 items: ~18 hours. Recommend pilot first 50 to validate spec.

raj: For dedupe, let's be conservative: fingerprint = sha1(normalized_text). Also add tokenized overlap filter > 0.8 to catch near-duplicates. Example SQL to fetch candidates: ```
SELECT p.id, sha1(lower(trim(p.text))) AS fp, p.token_count
FROM prompts p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM anchor_v1 a WHERE a.fp = sha1(lower(trim(p.text)))
)
AND p.token_count BETWEEN 1 AND 4096
LIMIT 10000;
```

ops-bot: Canary route created: model=mT-7b-v2, env=staging, traffic=0.5%, tag=holdout-redesign-canary.

maya: Raj — can you run quant smoke (int8 and q4f16) with the same random seeds and the new eval harness branch mt/holdout-redesign? Capture top-k nll, exact-match, and normalized edit distance. Upload to s3://redwood-evals/mT-7b-v2/holdout-redesign/ with timestamps.

raj: Running now, ETA ~12h. I'll include seed list and model card notes. Will compare fp16 baseline vs int8 vs q4f16.

sophia: Labeling ask: we need 600 anchor samples for calibration across strata (100 per cell for 6 cells). Start with 100 pilot (random per stratum) to sanity-check spec + edge cases (code with inline docstrings, loops, non-latin scripts). @alex can you prep the annotation spec and sample examples?

alex: I'll draft spec and 50 example annotations by EOD. Key instructions: "preserve whitespace for code, include expected output, mark hallucinations explicitly, include confidence label (1-5)". I'll also add a short rubric for ambiguous answers.

maya: Also need multilingual normalization rules for dedupe: apply NFKC, lowercase, remove diacritics only for comparison (keep original text for annotation), collapse punctuation-sequence to single token. Example normalizer snippet: ```python
import re, unicodedata

def norm(s):
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', s)
    s = re.sub(r"\s+"," ", s).strip()
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r"[\p{P}\p{S}]+", " ", s)  # collapse punctuation
    return s
```

sophia: :thumbsup: I'll update the eval harness partitions and create anchor_v2 with described strata. Will also tag samples with provenance fields: source, ingest_batch, dedupe_fp.

maya: Timeline: pilot 50 labeled samples + quant smoke by tomorrow EOD. If pilot looks good, spin up full 600 anchor labeling next week and retire anchor_v1. Also need folks to update model onboarding checklist to include this new holdout partitioning.

eng-releases: Noted. If canary metrics look fine, we'll schedule a limited rollout and coordinate infra (autoscale pools + dedicated routing) — please post the canary eval summary in #eng-releases when ready.

raj: I'll post artifacts and a short digest when runs finish.

alex: Spec posted: s3://redwood-annotations/specs/mt-holdout-2026-v1.md (pilot set attached). Starting pilot now.

maya: Great. Sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to review pilot and quant outputs. Thanks everyone!
